description: Citation-pattern check for one query. Use this when the user has the pages an AI answer or Google AI Overview cited for a search and asks what those pages have in common, or why their own page is not cited. Pass query, cited_urls (2 to 6 public addresses the user copied from the answer's sources) and exactly one of url, html or text for the user's page. Reads the pages (public only, robots.txt respected) and returns the gaps first: each signal most cited pages share and the user's page lacks (answer in the opening sentence, a heading with the query's words, a question heading, a table, a list, a date from the last year, links out, schema types, length), with counts such as 4 of 5 and a fix. Every signal is also listed, with the facts read from each page. It does not read Google or any AI engine, so the user must supply the cited addresses; never guess them. It stores nothing, so change over days needs a new call on a later day. A shared signal is a pattern in a small sample, not a proven cause, and no citation is promised. Do not use it for private addresses.
